Take the long way to your first cup.

 

A fragrant new oolong, ready for a slower morning.

01

FIRST POUR

 

Warm the pot, add the leaves and follow the brewing notes on your pack.

02

TASTE AS YOU GO

 

A short steep keeps the cup light. Add a little time when you want more body.

03

ANOTHER ROUND

 

Keep the leaves for a second infusion and notice how the flavour changes.
